metadata.description: RelAI — your project remembers everything. Documentation-first process framework for Claude Code.

plugins.name: relai
plugins.description: Your project remembers everything — documentation-first process framework for Claude Code

plugins.name: relai-panel
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.293). RelAI panel: the active plan and stage and the session's cost above the prompt; /relai-panel opens forms for the 14 RelAI commands, a map of plans and stages, the project documents and the session's measured costs. Every change goes through a confirmation card. One network request only: the Anthropic pricing page, read after "Tak" on a card.

plugins.name: relai-progress
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.293). RelAI progress above the prompt: the stage in progress, a /relai-crew run or work outside a plan, and /relai-agents with the session's subagents. Reads files only: no model call, no network. Based on savvy-progress by johnnyvizz (MIT).

plugins.name: relai-cache-keeper
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.293). The prompt-cache countdown, the context size and the cost of writing the cache again, above the prompt; asks before a cold send of a big context. Calls the model only on the person's request (keep-warm pings, hand-off to a fresh chat).
